CellUnderVoltage.description: A cell voltage is approaching the undervoltage fault limit.

CellOverVoltage.description: A cell voltage is approaching the overvoltage fault limit.

CellOverTemp.description: A cell temperature is approaching the overtemperature fault limit.

CellUnderTemp.description: A cell temperature is below the undertemperature limit (higher while charging, to avoid lithium plating).

TsOvercurrent.description: Tractive system current exceeded the overcurrent limit.

ItmpOverTemp.description: An ADBMS internal die temperature (ITMP) is approaching the critical limit.

CellUndervoltage.description: A cell voltage is below the critical undervoltage limit.

CellOvervoltage.description: A cell voltage is above the critical overvoltage limit.

CellOvertemp.description: A cell temperature is above the critical overtemperature limit (lower while charging).

CellOpenWire.description: The C-ADC or S-ADC open wire check found an open cell voltage sense line.

HealthError.description: The ADBMS reported an OV/UV comparator, thermal shutdown, self test or supply fault, or its diagnostic or open wire results stopped updating.

TESTFAULT.description: For unit testing only. Never raise this fault in firmware.

CellVoltageInvalid.description: One or more cell voltage readings failed, disagree between the C-ADC and S-ADC, or stopped updating.

ItmpOvertemp.description: An ADBMS internal die temperature (ITMP) is above the critical limit.

StackOverflow.description: An RTOS task stack overflowed during the previous boot.

MissingVCHeartbeat.description: Missing heartbeat signal from the VC.

ThermOpenWire.description: An open wire was detected on a thermistor sense line.

CellTempInvalid.description: One or more thermistor readings failed or are out of range (open or shorted thermistor).

CellUnderVoltage.description: A cell voltage dropped below the low voltage info threshold.

CellOverVoltage.description: A cell voltage rose above the high voltage info threshold.

CellOverTemp.description: A cell temperature rose above the high temperature info threshold.

CellImbalance.description: The spread between the highest and lowest cell voltages is too large.
